education.detail: M.A. (Lit.), Andhra University, 2009; M.Ed., Ambedkar University, 2011

declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section in the case carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 1 of 7 cases qualifies (IPC 452, house-trespass after preparation for hurt/assault, max 7yr, alongside 354, assault on a woman to outrage modesty, amended max 5yr); the rest are public-order/negligence/NI-Act sections under 5yr. Charges were framed in 2 of the 7 (both non-serious); zero convictions in any.
